title: HSK 1.7 · 准备, 高兴, 一会儿, 开车, 开玩笑
focus: 岁 · 行 · 号 · 放 · 朋友 · 住 · 拿 · 高 · 准备 · 水 · 进 · 写 · 您 · 送 · 分 · 笑 · 汽车 · 高兴 · 忘 · 记 · 一边 · 忘记 · 一半 · 进去 · 天气 · 进来 · 女生 · 生气 · 一会儿 · 记住 · 开车 · 火车 · 女朋友 · 男朋友 · 水果 · 白天 · 开玩笑 · 生病 · 开会
body:
Actions and feelings: going in and out (进), forgetting and remembering (忘, 记), and 开 (open, start) for driving, meetings and jokes. 车, 朋友 and 生 also come back.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 开 | kāi | open; drive; hold | 开车, 开玩笑, 开会 |
| 进 | jìn | enter (辶 + 井) | 进去, 进来 |
| 记 | jì | record, remember (讠 + 己 jǐ) | 忘记, 记住 |
| 车 | chē | vehicle | 汽车, 开车, 火车 |
| 一 | yī | one | 一边, 一半, 一会儿 |
| 生 | shēng | produce; student | 女生, 生气, 生病 |
| 朋友 | péngyou | friend | 女朋友, 男朋友 |
| 气 | qì | air; temper | 天气, 生气 |

## Watch out

- 忘 (wàng, forget) vs 忙 (máng, busy): the same 亡 and heart, but 忙 puts 忄 on the left.
- 进 (jìn, enter) vs 近 (jìn, near): same sound, 井 vs 斤.
- 汽 (steam, in 汽车) vs 气 (air): 汽 adds 氵 water.
- 行 is xíng (OK, walk) here; háng in 银行 (bank).
- 一 changes tone in speech: yìbiān, yíbàn, yíhuìr.

cards.Example: 你几岁? nǐ jǐ suì: How old are you?
cards.Notes: 山 mountain + 夕 evening (simplified from 歲)

cards.Meaning: OK, will do; (háng) row, line of business
cards.Example: 行,没问题。 xíng, méi wèntí: OK, no problem.
cards.Notes: 彳 + 亍: a picture of a crossroads. háng in 银行 (bank)

cards.Example: 今天几号? jīntiān jǐ hào: What's the date today?
cards.Notes: 口 mouth + 丂 below. 号 vs 另 (lìng, another)

cards.Meaning: to put, place; to let go
cards.Example: 放在这里。 fàng zài zhèlǐ: Put it here.
cards.Notes: 方 fāng for the sound + 攵 (a hand acting)

cards.Example: 他是我的朋友。 tā shì wǒ de péngyou: He's my friend.
cards.Notes: 朋 is two 月 side by side; 友 vs 反: 反 has a 厂 cliff on top

cards.Example: 我住在这儿。 wǒ zhù zài zhèr: I live here.
cards.Notes: 亻 person + 主 zhǔ; 住 vs 往 (wǎng): 往 has the double-person 彳

cards.Example: 你拿一下。 nǐ ná yíxià: Hold this for a sec.
cards.Notes: 合 put together + 手 hand: hands closing on something

cards.Example: 他很高。 tā hěn gāo: He's tall.
cards.Notes: Picture of a tall tower with a roof

cards.Example: 你准备好了吗? nǐ zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma: Are you ready?
cards.Notes: 准 accurate, set (冫 + 隹) + 备 prepare = get ready

cards.Example: 我想喝水。 wǒ xiǎng hē shuǐ: I want some water.
cards.Notes: Picture of flowing water; as a radical it becomes 氵

cards.Example: 请进! qǐng jìn: Come in!
cards.Notes: 辶 movement + 井. 进 vs 近 (jìn, near), which has 斤

cards.Example: 我在写字。 wǒ zài xiě zì: I'm writing.
cards.Notes: 冖 cover + 与 (simplified from 寫)

cards.Example: 您好! nín hǎo: Hello (polite)!
cards.Notes: 你 you + 心 heart: 'you' said with heart = polite you

cards.Meaning: to give (a gift); to see off; to deliver
cards.Example: 我送你回家。 wǒ sòng nǐ huíjiā: I'll take you home.
cards.Notes: 辶 movement + 关-like top: sending something on its way

cards.Example: 我们分一下。 wǒmen fēn yíxià: Let's split it.
cards.Notes: 八 separate + 刀 knife: cut apart. 分 vs 今 (jīn)

cards.Example: 你笑什么? nǐ xiào shénme: What are you laughing at?
cards.Notes: ⺮ bamboo top + 夭 below; 10 strokes

cards.Example: 这是我的汽车。 zhè shì wǒ de qìchē: This is my car.
cards.Notes: 汽 steam, gas (氵 + 气) + 车 vehicle = motor vehicle

cards.Example: 我很高兴。 wǒ hěn gāoxìng: I'm really happy.
cards.Notes: 高 high + 兴 mood, excitement = high spirits

cards.Example: 别忘了! bié wàng le: Don't forget!
cards.Notes: 亡 wáng (lost, also the sound) over 心 heart: lost from the heart

cards.Example: 我记不清了。 wǒ jì bu qīng le: I don't remember clearly.
cards.Notes: 讠 speech + 己 jǐ for the sound. 己 vs 已 (yǐ) vs 巳 (sì)

cards.Example: 他一边吃一边说。 tā yìbiān chī yìbiān shuō: He talks while eating.
cards.Notes: 一 one + 边 side; 一边…一边… = doing two things at once

cards.Example: 我忘记了。 wǒ wàngjì le: I forgot.
cards.Notes: 忘 = 亡 wáng over 心 heart; 记 = 讠 + 己 jǐ (己 vs 已 yǐ)

cards.Example: 给你一半。 gěi nǐ yíbàn: Here's half for you.
cards.Notes: 一 one + 半 half

cards.Example: 我们进去吧。 wǒmen jìnqu ba: Let's go in.
cards.Notes: 进 enter + 去 go (away from the speaker) = go in

cards.Example: 今天天气很好。 jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo: The weather's nice today.
cards.Notes: 天 sky + 气 air = weather

cards.Example: 快进来! kuài jìnlai: Come on in!
cards.Notes: 进 enter + 来 come (toward the speaker) = come in

cards.Example: 那个女生是谁? nàge nǚshēng shì shéi: Who's that girl?
cards.Notes: 女 female + 生 student = girl

cards.Example: 别生气了。 bié shēngqì le: Don't be mad.
cards.Notes: 生 produce + 气 air, temper = to work up a temper

cards.Example: 等一会儿。 děng yíhuìr: Wait a moment.
cards.Notes: 一 one + 会 meeting, moment + 儿 (r ending) = a short while

cards.Example: 你记住了吗? nǐ jìzhu le ma: Have you got that memorized?
cards.Notes: 记 remember + 住 stay = make it stick

cards.Example: 我会开车。 wǒ huì kāichē: I can drive.
cards.Notes: 开 operate + 车 vehicle = drive

cards.Example: 我坐火车去。 wǒ zuò huǒchē qù: I'm going by train.
cards.Notes: 火 fire + 车 vehicle = steam train

cards.Example: 这是我女朋友。 zhè shì wǒ nǚpéngyou: This is my girlfriend.
cards.Notes: 女 female + 朋友 friend

cards.Example: 她有男朋友吗? tā yǒu nánpéngyou ma: Does she have a boyfriend?
cards.Notes: 男 male + 朋友 friend

cards.Example: 我想吃水果。 wǒ xiǎng chī shuǐguǒ: I want some fruit.
cards.Notes: 水 water + 果 fruit (果 = fruit on 木 tree) = juicy fruit

cards.Example: 我白天上班。 wǒ báitiān shàngbān: I work during the day.
cards.Notes: 白 white, bright + 天 day = daytime

cards.Example: 我开玩笑的。 wǒ kāi wánxiào de: I'm just kidding.
cards.Notes: 开 start + 玩 play + 笑 laugh = make a joke

cards.Example: 我生病了。 wǒ shēngbìng le: I'm sick.
cards.Notes: 生 produce, get + 病 illness = fall ill

cards.Example: 我在开会。 wǒ zài kāihuì: I'm in a meeting.
cards.Notes: 开 hold + 会 meeting = have a meeting
